name: – Andrzej Halicki – Before § 1 – Am 3
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: ‑1. Calls for the EU budget to be ramped up in an effort to tackle the socio-economic plight that peoples and Member States are facing, which has been compounded by the rising cost of living, among other aspects;
